turns.question: What was our refund rate by value on the orders placed on 1 and 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no refund-rate-by-value metric (a share of order value refunded); the closest metrics are Return rate (return_rate, a share of orders by count, not by value), Returns (EUR) (returns_eur), Revenue (EUR) (revenue_eur) and Net revenue (EUR) (net_revenue_eur). For reference, the Return rate on orders placed 1-2 October 2026 was 0.1 (10 % of orders, by count). Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
